text.27:83: And (remind them of) the Day when We shall gather out of every nation a host of those who denied Our revelations, and they will be set in array;
text.38:59: Here is an army rushing blindly with you. (Those who are already in the Fire say): No word of welcome for them. Lo! they will roast at the Fire.
text.67:8: As it would burst with rage. Whenever a (fresh) host is flung therein the wardens thereof ask them: Came there unto you no warner?
text.78:18: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,
text.110:2: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,
